fullPassage: Stated simply, we evolved to be as inactive as possible. Or to be more precise, our bodies were selected to spend enough but not too much energy on nonreproductive functions including physical activity. Note that I included the qualifier "as possible" because, obviously, one cannot survive or thrive without moving. As a young hunter-gatherer, you would need to play to develop athletic skills, gain strength, and build stamina. As an adult, you would have no choice but to seek out food, do chores, find mates, and avoid being killed. You would probably also need and want to participate in important social rituals like dancing. But whenever energy is scarce, as it usually was, any gratuitous physical activity would reduce how much energy you could devote to survival and reproduction. No sensible adult hunter-gatherer would waste five hundred calories running five miles just for kicks.

✅ ④ waste: would waste(조동사+원형) 올바름.

det.korean: gratuitous(불필요한): 에너지가 부족할 때 '불필요한' 활동은 낭비라는 맥락입니다.

❌ ① essential: '필수적인' 활동이면 줄이면 안 됨.
❌ ② important: '중요한' 활동은 본문에서 social rituals에 사용.
❌ ③ athletic: '운동의'는 본문 앞부분의 skills 설명에 사용.

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 성인 수렵채집인은 음식을 찾고 집안일을 할 수밖에 없었습니다.

✅ ① 성인 수렵채집인은 음식을 찾고 집안일을 할 수밖에 없었다: 원문 일치.
❌ ② 인간은 가능한 한 활동적이도록 진화했다: inactive.
❌ ③ 에너지는 수렵채집 시대에 대체로 풍부했다: scarce.
❌ ④ 수렵채집인은 재미로 달리기를 즐겼다: would not waste.
det.tip: have no choice but to V = ~할 수밖에 없다

det.korean: '가능한 한'이라는 수식어가 불필요하다는 것은 원문과 일치하지 않습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 우리 몸은 비생식적 기능에 너무 많은 에너지를 쓰지 않도록 선택되었다: 원문 일치.
✅ ② 어린 수렵채집인은 놀이를 통해 체력을 쌓아야 했다: 원문 일치.
